findings.issue: API route paths are defined without a leading slash, causing them to be treated as relative routes and resulting in 404 errors for the intended endpoints.
findings.fix:
Add a leading slash to the API route definitions:
```ts
export default [
  index("routes/landing.tsx"),
  route("/auth", "routes/auth.tsx"),
  route("/logout", "routes/logout.tsx"),
  route("/api/v1/chat/completions", "routes/api.v1.chat.completions.ts"),
  route("/api/v1/models", "routes/api.v1.models.ts"),
  route("/dashboard", "routes/dashboard/layout.tsx", [
    index("routes/dashboard/home.tsx"),
    route("chat", "routes/dashboard/chat.tsx"),
    route("key-management", "routes/dashboard/key-management.tsx"),
    route("proxy-configuration", "routes/dashboard/proxy-configuration.tsx"),
    route("usage-logs", "routes/dashboard/usage-logs.tsx"),
    route("settings", "routes/dashboard/settings.tsx"),
  ]),
] satisfies RouteConfig;
```

findings.issue: The base URL is escaped with `replace(/"/g, "\\\"")` and then passed to `JSON.stringify`, resulting in a double‑escaped string being injected into the page (`window.__OMNIBRIDGE_BASE_URL__`). This yields an incorrect value at runtime.
